import pandas as pd

def load(existing, batch):
    combined = pd.concat([existing, batch], ignore_index=True)
    latest = combined.sort_values("loaded_at").drop_duplicates("order_id", keep="last")
    return latest.sort_values("order_id").reset_index(drop=True)


existing = pd.DataFrame({"order_id": [1, 2], "status": ["shipped", "delivered"], "loaded_at": ["2026-11-01", "2026-11-01"]})
batch = pd.DataFrame({"order_id": [1, 3], "status": ["delivered", "delivered"], "loaded_at": ["2026-11-02", "2026-11-02"]})
once = load(existing, batch)
twice = load(once, batch)
print(once)
print(once.equals(twice))

_once = load(_e, _b)
assert _once is not None, 'remember to return the DataFrame'
assert list(_once['order_id']) == [1, 2, 3], 'one row per order_id, sorted by order_id'

from datetime import date, timedelta

def backfill_dates(start, end, done):
    d = date.fromisoformat(start)
    last = date.fromisoformat(end)
    out = []
    while d <= last:
        if d.isoformat() not in done:
            out.append(d.isoformat())
        d += timedelta(days=1)
    return out

print(backfill_dates("2026-10-01", "2026-10-07", {"2026-10-01", "2026-10-02", "2026-10-03", "2026-10-07"}))

sc4-1.solution: SELECT changed_at::DATE AS day, COUNT(*) AS new_orders FROM order_events WHERE op = 'c' AND changed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND changed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' GROUP BY day;

sc4-2.solution: WITH times AS (SELECT order_id, MIN(changed_at) FILTER (WHERE status = 'placed') AS placed_at, MIN(changed_at) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered') AS delivered_at FROM order_events GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(date_diff('minute', placed_at, delivered_at)) / 60, 1) AS avg_hours FROM times WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL;

sc5-1.solution: SELECT order_id, status, changed_at AS valid_from, LEAD(changed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY lsn) AS valid_to FROM order_events WHERE op <> 'd';

sc5-2.solution: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM order_events QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY lsn DESC) = 1) SELECT order_id, changed_at AS shipped_at FROM latest WHERE status = 'shipped' AND changed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-19' - INTERVAL 7 DAY;

pd4-2.solution: WITH done AS (SELECT customer_id FROM deletion_requests WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT 'customers' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM done) UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_contacts', COUNT(*) FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM done) UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM done);

pd5-1.solution: WITH who AS (SELECT customer_id FROM deletion_requests WHERE request_id = 902) SELECT 'customers' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows, 'delete' AS action FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM who) UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_contacts', COUNT(*), 'delete' FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM who) UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_history', COUNT(*), 'delete' FROM customer_history WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM who) UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', COUNT(*), 'anonymise' FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM who) UNION ALL SELECT 'raw_orders_feed', COUNT(*), 'anonymise' FROM raw_orders_feed WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM who);

jb3-1.solution: WITH revenue AS (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS i JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name) SELECT category, product_name, revenue FROM revenue QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name) <= 2;

jb3-2.solution: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE year(order_date) = 2025) AS y25 WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE year(order_date) = 2026);

jb3-3.solution: WITH monthly AS (SELECT month(o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND year(o.order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 1) AS growth_pct FROM monthly ORDER BY month;

def dedupe(rows):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        if r['order_id'] not in seen:
            seen.add(r['order_id'])
            out.append(r)
    return out

rows = [
    {'order_id': 1, 'total': 10},
    {'order_id': 2, 'total': 20},
    {'order_id': 1, 'total': 10},
]
print(dedupe(rows))
